AudioFlipper 1.1 adds a microphone section, a webcam switch and a tidier menu to the taskbar widget.

## New

- **Input section** for your microphone, next to the output one: its Windows icon and name and the
  input level. Click to switch to the next microphone, scroll to change the level, middle-click to
  mute, and hover for a level slider.
- **Webcam on/off**: a camera icon on the widget turns a chosen webcam on and off (like Disable
  device in Device Manager), struck through while it's off. Pick the webcam under **Webcam** in the
  right-click menu, which also links to Camera settings.
  - Windows needs administrator rights to switch a webcam, so by default each switch shows a prompt.
    **Webcam → Switch without asking each time** asks once instead and then switches without
    prompts. It sets up two scheduled tasks that only run Windows' own PnP Utility for that webcam.
- **Reorganized menu**: **Output**, **Input** and **Webcam** submenus, each with a **Show on
  taskbar** switch for its section and its own settings. Hide all three to use just the tray icon.
- `AudioFlipper.exe --next-input` switches microphones from a shortcut or keyboard hotkey.

## Fixed

- The widget no longer disappears when you take a screenshot (Print Screen, Snagit). It now hides
  only for real full-screen apps, the same way the taskbar does, and no longer covers screenshot
  overlays or always-on-top windows.
- **Start with Windows** keeps working when you replace or move AudioFlipper.exe, and the menu only
  shows it as on when Windows will actually start it.

## Installing or updating

Download **AudioFlipper.exe** below. If you're updating, exit the running copy (right-click the
widget → **Exit**) and replace your old AudioFlipper.exe with the new one. Your settings are kept.
It's not code-signed, so Windows may show "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info → Run
anyway**.
